name: xxd-keyboard-maestro-site
description: Keyboard Maestro 新手教程站（非官方）：把 Mac 上每天重复的打字、点击和开 App 交给宏，从第一个宏到变量、剪贴板和调试，说人话。界面用 xxd-ui-kit。

scripts.build: astro build && node scripts/search-sections.mjs && node scripts/base-links.mjs
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run check && ! grep -rlE '待写|TBD:' src/pages src/views src/i18n && wrangler deploy
scripts.check: node scripts/check-i18n.mjs && node scripts/check-site.mjs && node scripts/check-ui-labels.mjs
